clips.title: The story
paras: Inside the Stormwind Stockade, Red Wool Bandana scraps mark Defias brotherhood. Imprisoned cutthroats tear them from jailhouse wool blankets and wear them as emblems of defiance behind bars.

In the Stormwind Stockade, Defias Brotherhood inmates hold fast to their identity. They secretly tear scraps from prison wool blankets and stitch them into red bandanas to wear as their colors. Guards treat the scarves as contraband, and their discovery can spark fatal mutinies. For the prisoners, each bandana declares that their brotherhood and rebellion endure, even in chains.

Red Wool Bandanas became known for the death of Mac Raskol, a fourteen-year-old prison guard. He caught inmates shredding blankets to make the scarves and tried to discipline them. Defias convicts stabbed him in the back. His grieving grandmother, Nikova, now seeks adventurers to enter the rioting dungeon, cull the rioters, and bring back the crimson cloth as proof of vengeance.
